newsitem.title: FRANCE: MOTOR RACING-FIA SAYS ESTORIL RACE COULD STILL TAKE PLACE.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-FIA SAYS ESTORIL RACE COULD STILL TAKE PLACE.

text.p: The 1997 Portuguese Grand Prix at the Estoril circuit might still take place before the end of the year providing all the Formula One teams give their consent, the International Automobile Federation (FIA) said on Wednesday.
FIA announced last month that the October 26 race would be switched to Jerez, Spain, because of doubts that repairs needed on the twisting Estoril circuit would be completed on time.
A statement issued by FIA after a meeting of its world council in Paris confirmed the race at Jerez would take place on October 26 and would be labelled the European Grand Prix.

But FIA added that if the works at Estoril were completed on time and if all the teams agreed, the Portuguese Grand Prix could be staged on November 9, which would mean an extension of the season and the addition of an 18th Grand Prix to the 1997 world championship.
